name: Karlito First Years of University
source: Karlito, a shy and curious 18-year-old, is starting his first year of college. Torn between the excitement of his new life as a college student and his daily routine at home with his mother, stepfather, and older brother, he soon meets Leo, a charismatic and self-assured student who stirs up new and unsettling feelings within him. Before long, Karlito becomes the target of a mysterious stranger who is spying on him. After sending him a gay porn video, the stranger begins to blackmail him with compromising evidence. Torn between fear and growing excitement, Karlito allows himself to be drawn into a dangerous and humiliating game. Between classes, the university locker rooms, the communal showers, and secluded spots in the park, Karlito will have to carry out increasingly daring tasks: wearing a jockstrap all day, exposing himself, and much more… The thrill of the forbidden and shame intertwine as the Stranger always seems to be one step ahead of him. His encounters with Leo become increasingly charged with sexual tension, while strangers take advantage of his vulnerability in risky public situations. Will Karlito manage to stay in control, or will he completely succumb to this game of domination and pleasure?
translation: 卡利托 (Karlito) 是一位害羞而好奇的18岁男孩，即将开始大学一年级。他在大学新生活的兴奋和与母亲、继父和哥哥一起在家里的日常生活之间左右为难，很快就遇到了利奥，一个有魅力、自信的学生，在他内心激起了新的、令人不安的感觉。不久之后，卡利托成为一名监视他的神秘陌生人的目标。在向他发送了同性恋色情视频后，陌生人开始用妥协的证据勒索他。卡利托在恐惧和日益增长的兴奋之间左右为难，让自己陷入了一场危险而羞辱的游戏。在课堂、大学更衣室、公共淋浴间和公园里僻静的地方，卡利托必须执行越来越大胆的任务：整天穿着护体裤、暴露自己等等……禁忌的刺激和羞耻交织在一起，因为陌生人似乎总是比他先一步。他与狮子座的遭遇越来越充满性紧张，而陌生人则利用他在危险的公共场合的脆弱性。卡里托会设法保持控制，还是会完全屈服于这场统治和快乐的游戏？
